newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Vnukovo Airlines cuts Moscow-Sochi rates.
newsitem.headline: Russian Vnukovo Airlines cuts Moscow-Sochi rates.

text.p: Russia's biggest domestic air carrier Vnukovo Airlines reduced rates on its scheduled Moscow-Sochi flights, a company spokesman said on Wednesday.
Alexander Klimov said the rate for a one-way ticket in economy class now costs 550,000 roubles ($95) compared with 650,000 roubles ($112) before.

"We have introduced low rates because many Russians use it to fly to this popular resort on the Black Sea coast for their holidays," he said, adding that the new rate would be available until the end of September.
Vnukovo makes four flights daily seven days a week on this route, using wide-body Ilyushin Il-86 jets.
"There are no free seats on these flights now," Klimov said.

He said the company carried 1.3 million passengers between January and June of this year, or two percent less than in the same period in 1996. Vnukovo carried a total 2.7 million passengers last year.
Klimov said the company currently operated 48 passenger and cargo aircraft, making scheduled flights to 47 domestic destinations.
